changelog: v1.0.4: Fixes Install Update. 1.0.2/1.0.3 could close mid-download and leave UnknownBearTranslator.exe.new. Delete that leftover, then use Downloader this once. Later updates install in the background without crashing.
downloader_changelog: Single-file forum drop. Unpacks WebView2 helpers into LocalAppData on first run. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Fetches Translator from translator-v1.0.4.
